bibl.title: Egyptianism. Appropriating "Egypt" in the "Isiac Cults" of the Graeco-Roman World.
bibl.seg: Valentino Gasparini & Richard L. Gordon, Egyptianism. Appropriating "Egypt" in the "Isiac Cults" of the Graeco-Roman World.
bibl.note: Modelling coherence: "early Christianity" and "Oriental religions". - The "lived ancient religion" approach. - "Persianism". - "Egyptianism". - Material culture: 1. Egyptian inscribed texts; - 2. Egyptian funerary rituals; - 3. Pharaonic "ear-stelae" and Graeco-Roman "Ohrenweihungen"; - 4. Re-styling Egyptian gods; - 5. Pharaonic and ‘Isiac’ sistra. - Conclusion.
